title: Why Local Search Citations Matter for Local SEO

facts.fact: Per a Safari Digital statistic cited by Keyword.com, Google receives more than 3.5 billion searches daily.
facts.quote: With more than 3.5 billion searches being received by Google daily

facts.fact: According to the article, 54% of users search for a local business once a month and 12% search every day.
facts.quote: with 54% searching once a month and 12% every day

facts.fact: Per a ThemeMediaCaptain statistic cited by the article, an average Google Business Profile receives 33 clicks per month.
facts.quote: an average Google Business Profile receives 33 clicks per month.
